ideas.name: NVIDIA Corporation
ideas.thesis: NVDA appeared in all 6 of 6 overnight screens with unanimous high conviction — the strongest consensus signal in this digest. The stock trades at a forward P/E of ~22x versus the Nasdaq-100 average of ~25x, its cheapest relative valuation in years, despite management guiding ~95% YoY revenue growth for Q2 FY2027. With the stock up only ~2% YTD vs. the S&P 500's +7%, the valuation and performance gap versus peers is historically wide into a high-beat-probability earnings print. A defined-risk call spread (e.g., Aug29 or Sep-expiry $230/$260) is the preferred structure to capture asymmetric upside while limiting exposure to NVDA's well-documented post-earnings sell-the-news volatility.
